text: Sorry, this might be nothing and I'm only his stepdad so I don't always know what's normal for him. My stepson is 5. About twenty minutes ago he went stiff and started shaking, and his eyes went up and back for a bit. I think it was maybe a minute? He's never done anything like that before. Then when I was getting him changed I noticed some little purple dots on his tummy, and I tried the glass thing I'd seen online and I don't think they faded at all. Not sure if the two things are connected or if I'm panicking over nothing.
